notes: Overnight trips stay overnight trips. When you're camping, at a sleepover, in a hotel or keeping watch somewhere, the app no longer tells characters they're supposed to be asleep at home and should leave, or that they're doing their usual home routine (like Manato making the kids breakfast); they sleep wherever the group set up. Characters with you on their free time are told their usual routine isn't happening today because they're with you. Every reply also reminds the AI where everyone physically is and that what was set up there (tents, a fire, who's on watch) is still true
